title: Muzaffer E NDE 5274
content: I was five or six years old, and my family and neighborhood friends took a pick-up to drive to Karatas (city) where there was an ocean beach. Even though the weather was not so good, everyone went swimming. I went into the water with my older brothers, but I couldn't swim and the waves pulled me into the open sea. I was always the shortest student in my class at school, and the water was way over my head - it was two to three times deeper than my height. From underwater, I looked up and saw the surface of the water where the waves were rolling over me. I could feel myself being pushed and pulled by the current. I passed out in the water, and then I felt myself moving upward. At the height of about ten meters above the water. I don't remember if I was still moving upward, or whether I had stopped. I looked down and saw a hand in the water. I didn't realize at the time that it was my hand - that's where my body was floating. I saw a young man lift me up and bring me back to the beach. The last thing I remember is, being held by the legs with my head down, and someone shaking me. This happened thirty years ago, and I still tell my experience to everyone. I do not care if people believe it or not - I know it was real, because it was I who experienced it. After many years, I found out that such experiences are called 'Near Death Experiences,' and I read some of them. In my experience, I did not see any bright light, but, like other NDErs, I absolutely do not fear death anymore. I am married and have two kids, but I do not fear death. During my experience, I was very comfortable, and that's how I learned how to be more focused and at ease in life.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt moving upward to about ten meters above the water.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Transitioned from being above the water to awareness of being held/shaken after rescue.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning in ocean waves/current as a child who could not swim.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: No tunnel, light, beings, or life review described; included 'return_choice' only as a stage marker for return (no choice mentioned).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Passed out underwater, then awareness of moving upward and observing rescue from above; then awareness of being held upside down and shaken.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Observed a hand in the water and did not realize it was his own hand/body location at the time.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I know it was real, because it was I who experienced it.”
